title.zh: Bitget’s $351.6 million hack pushes September crypto losses to 2026 high
title.en: Bitget’s $351.6 million hack pushes September crypto losses to 2026 high

current_state.zh: Bitget suspended withdrawals after unauthorized transfers of roughly $351.6 million from hot and warm wallets, making September 2026 the costliest month for crypto thefts this year.
